recognize_zh: 視野中央一個略帶灰藍（多染性）的紅血球內有三個深紫色包涵體：兩個小圓點與一個新月形團塊，排列成笑臉狀；這些緻密、邊界清楚的紫色核殘餘就是 Howell-Jolly 小體。
features: Single slightly grey-blue (polychromatophilic) red cell containing three discrete dense purple inclusions
Two small round inclusions and one larger crescent-shaped inclusion, each sharply defined
Inclusions are smooth and homogeneous, not refractile, and lie within the red cell
Adjacent small round dark lymphocyte and a larger immature mononuclear cell at the field edge
Background normochromic red cells; image has a yellow-green color cast
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a slightly polychromatophilic red cell containing three sharply defined, dense, dark purple inclusions: two small round bodies and one crescent-shaped body. The inclusions are homogeneous and non-refractile, consistent with nuclear remnants. A small lymphocyte and a larger immature mononuclear cell are present nearby, and the image has a yellow-green color cast that limits assessment of subtle staining. Findings are consistent with multiple Howell-Jolly bodies, which may reflect hyposplenism or dyserythropoiesis, in a patient under follow-up for acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Smaller, multiple grey-blue granules clustered at the cell periphery that stain with Prussian blue, rather than one to three dense round purple bodies.
Numerous fine to coarse blue dots distributed evenly throughout the red cell.
Rings have a chromatin dot attached to a delicate blue cytoplasmic ring, whereas Howell-Jolly bodies are solid round bodies without cytoplasm.
Platelets have granular purple centers with a pale halo and lie in a different focal plane.
